newsitem.title: UK: Prism completes rights issue for franchises.
newsitem.headline: Prism completes rights issue for franchises.

text.p: British passenger railway operating company Prism Rail Plc said on Tuesday its 11-for-26 rights issue for 5.5 million shares set last month to underpin its franchises for two Welsh rail lines had been completed.
In a statement it said 5,444,737 new shares, representing about 99 percent of the issue, were taken up by shareholders or placed by Williams de Broe.
The shares had been offered at 240 pence in mid-October, a price which compared to its current share price of 370p, up 8.0p from Monday's close.
The remaining 55,000 shares not taken up by shareholders will be sold in the market on their behalf by Williams de Broe.

The issue, intended to raise about 12.5 million stg, was to fund a capitalisation requirement laid down by the government Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (Opraf) in September when it awarded Prism the franchises for South Wales & West Railway and Cardiff Railway Compnay Ltd.
Prism already operated the London, Tilbury and Southend line. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
